configuration_candidate.ramp_change: Copy the actual bundled example into a writable test directory; require exactly one Ramp - nus: token and rename only that token to documented Ramp - nu:. Keep every numerical parameter, 900nodes, 0.15s and 0.0001 timestep unchanged. Run the actual simulator with strict exit0 and require new nonempty finite time-series output, consistent columns and increasing timestamps. Existing EIRS coupling ramp already executes successfully with nu; this does not prove the corrected separate fixture until tested.
configuration_candidate.timestamp_change: Copy the unchanged stimuli-only configuration into a fresh writable directory and run nftsim -i <copied-config> -t without -o. Require exactly one new nonempty output with ISO timestamp filename and real numeric samples. An explicit -o would override timestamp naming in the documented CLI and is therefore not a valid test of -t.
configuration_candidate.negative_contracts: Replace the two Error handled shell fallbacks with actual documented nonzero exits and substantive diagnostics once observed; preserve negative-test intent. Retain exact PAS exit1/missing-fCaP assertion and every other scientific test.
configuration_candidate.provenance_limit: Current suite checks vendor version and only the 40-hex format of source-commit; it does not record/assert the actual vendor source commit. Historical upstream rename is documented, not proof that every vendor source byte equals official0bd35df. No dependency/application-source patch proposed.
configuration_candidate.budget: No recipe/test edits or dispatch before explicit renewed12-hour/max11 allowance. Eight accounted attempts now include two recovered external jobs and one earlier unstarted reservation; retain original start/deadline and all old proof. Three fresh jobs would bring total11. No claim of native success or automatic publication.
